# Ali Naderi

> Machine learning researcher and software engineer from Iran. Works on deep learning for 3D medical imaging (automated breast ultrasound), and builds backend, embedded and open-source software. MSc in Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Iran University of Science and Technology (IUST).

This is the personal site of Ali Naderi (Ali Naderi Parizi; GitHub: mralinp). It holds a blog, project write-ups, research, book reviews and a CV. Everything is written by Ali unless a post says otherwise. The full text of every page is in [llms-full.txt]({{ base }}/llms-full.txt).
